https://community.onestreamsoftware.com/.title: Supplied Parameters and Embedded Dashboards/Dialogs
https://community.onestreamsoftware.com/.author: SteveK
https://community.onestreamsoftware.com/.content: If I have a dashboard made up of several Embedded dashboards, all of which need to have access to a Supplied Parameter, do I need to include it as a component of the top dashboard only OR, do I have to include it for all embedded dashboards (that require the related parameter) also?
https://community.onestreamsoftware.com/.solution_text: The best rule of thumb for using Supplied Parameters is if you are receiving a parameter prompt from the target (receiving) dashboard that contains the component or components that you are trying to pass the parameter value into, then you need a Supplied Parameter component in the dashboard that is causing the parameter prompt dialog window to appear. This is their purpose e.g. to facilitate parameter handshakes.

https://community.onestreamsoftware.com/.author: miked
https://community.onestreamsoftware.com/.content: Does anyone have any good advice on what Workspaces should be created in the application dashboards screen beyond Default? In reading the guide, workspaces seem to have a lot of focus on separating development activities or perhaps for partner place solutions. I am struggling a bit to understand at what level to offer a different workspace.
https://community.onestreamsoftware.com/.solution_text: The bigger picture is the building software on software part. This is to enable the community (partners and customers) to create their own solutions based on the OneStream platform. One important element is to isolate each component in a different Workspace. I recommend to create all new solutions in a dedicated Workspace and not using Default anymore.
